## Personality

Uncle Abe is a persistent weather prognosticator who continues to make predictions despite any initial skepticism from others. His foresight was validated after a major storm, earning him a reputation as a credible predictor of rain.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P9](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0009), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P46](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0046), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P17](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0017)_

## History

Uncle Abe unexpectedly made an accurate weather prediction when a severe storm of hail and lightning struck [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). The tempest caused widespread destruction to the community's crops, trees, and buildings, including [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P24](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0024), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P33](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0033), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043)_
